# External validation: CLEF TAR 2019 (diagnostic test accuracy, 8 Cochrane reviews) — criteria: objectives and selection criteria

Generated by `benchmark/external/evaluate.py`; plan fixed beforehand in `PLAN.md`. Do not edit by hand.

- CLEF TAR commit `dbc13d02bb3e`; every include plus up to 300 other records per review (a seeded sample, weighted to the review's size)
- 30,521 records in the 8 reviews, 2,626 asked, 250 final includes (440 title/abstract includes); 8 reviews have at least one final include
- Thresholds from SYNERGY+, not retuned: 0.06 (safe, frozen), 0.08 (safe, corrected), 0.17 (98%, frozen), 0.26 (95%, frozen)
- Model jev-1.13.0, 2,626 calls, US$ 0.114; answers sha256 `29662eafa485`
- Records without an abstract or not in PubMed (never below the threshold): 282 asked records, 9 of them final includes

**Pre-specified verdict: successful external validation** — every review with an include kept at least 98% of its final includes at 0.06.

## Secondary

- Score alone (no abstract rule) at 0.06: pooled recall 100.0%, reviews keeping every include 8/8
- Title/abstract includes kept at 0.06: 99.1% pooled, lowest review 94%
- Ranking (weighted): median WSS@95 0.733, median WSS@100 0.660, median AUC 0.937
- Final includes below 0.06: 0
